description: Mark a step of the setup checklist completed or skipped for the person this token acts for, as the console's Mark as complete and Skip controls do; open removes the mark. Give step for one milestone, or group to mark every open step of that group (the console's Skip all). A marked step counts as done on that person's checklist and its status says how; reached stays false until SHIP sees the step done. Returns the checklist as it now stands. A token that acts for no person is refused.

group.description: A group id: marks every open step of the group.

step.description: The milestone id from get_setup_progress. Give step or group.

name: mark_setup_step
title: Mark a setup step
